item: A. BnF fr.3040 no.6 f.18r L11-L21 (Gramont, bishop of Tarbes, to Montmorency, 'A Boulongne' [Bologna], 28 March 1530), 403 cipher tokens, 287 keyed (N9-GRA4, 5 Oct 2026)
final_class: N0 (Audit 1 VER1-GRA and Audit 2 DEF1-GRACOS, 5 Oct 2026); D2, 71.2%; key published; text known; not counted as a unique solve
source_type: documentary edition (Le Grand Preuves) + period gloss same leaf + official-records calendar (L&P) + cipher blog (Tomokiyo)
source: Le Grand, Histoire du divorce III (Preuves, 1688) pp.454-457, 'Lettre de Mr. de Gramont Evesque de Tarbe a Mr. de Montmorency', Bethune vol. 8565 = BnF fr.3040 (finding aid cc49499h, 'Ancienne cote: Anc. 8565'); also the leaf's own contemporary marginal decipherment beside the f.18r block (Gallica btv1b9059870w canvas 32); L&P iv(3) no.6293 p.2829 (margin 'Le Grand, iii. 454'); Tomokiyo francis.htm 'f.18 (no.6) from Boulogne, both deciphered'
spent_before_catch: none for novelty: the leaf was chosen (N8-GRA2 4 Oct, N8-GRA3, N9-GRA4 5 Oct) because Le Grand prints it, as known plaintext to grade key.tsv; two blind passes, reconciliation and scoring were the intended use; the N0 class was assigned afterwards by two audits. No dollar figure stated in AUDIT.md.
cheapest_catch: Grep the cached Tomokiyo page sources/cryptiana/web/francis.htm for the shelfmark 'fr.3040' (returns 'f.18 (no.6) from Boulogne, both deciphered'); then match the BnF finding aid's 'Ancienne cote: Anc. 8565' (archivesetmanuscrits cc49499h) to the 'Bethune vol. 8565' heading in Le Grand III's dateline list (MDZ OCR bsb10280117, scans 460-463, already on the second audit's list); one IIIF view of canvas 32 shows the marginal gloss. For the calendar: be-api fts on IA 11332111bsb with an English rendering of a plaintext phrase ('dancers') or 'Tarbes Montmorency', not the leaf's spellings.
why_missed: Not missed: deliberate known-plaintext key check (it raised ST = L to grade C, used on the surviving f.30). Facts found late: N8-GRA2 saw the marginal notes and left them 'not read'; nobody tied Bethune 8565 to fr.3040 until Audit 1; Audit 1 searched L&P with the leaf's spellings ('Rochford', 'Boulogne') and missed no.6293 (the calendar spells 'Rocheford' and dates it from Bologna); DECODE record 4227 says 'Non-decrypted' and Bourdeau's excluded.json wrongly says 'read (targets/gramont1529/)', so both catalogue flags were misleading.

item: B. BnF fr.3040 no.6, whole letter (f.18r L01-L21, f.18v L01-L23, f.19r L01-L02), Gramont to Montmorency, 28 March 1530, 1693 cipher tokens, 1302 keyed (N8-GRA2 + N8-GRA3 + N9-GRA4)
final_class: N0 (two audits, 5 Oct 2026); D2, 76.9%; key published plus ST = L at C (ours, from this letter's print); not counted
source_type: documentary edition + period gloss same leaf + official-records calendar + scholarship citation
source: Le Grand III pp.454-457 (Bethune 8565 = fr.3040); period marginal decipherment on f.18r (Audit 1) and f.18v (Audit 2, canvas 33); L&P iv(3) no.6293 p.2829; Ehses, Romische Dokumente (1893) cites 'Le Grand III. 454'; Katharine of Aragon (2013) cites L&P 6290/6293
spent_before_catch: none for novelty: three transcription/scoring jobs (N8-GRA2, N8-GRA3, N9-GRA4) plus key-grade verifiers VER-GRACOS and N9-GRAV were run knowingly against the print as a key check; dollar figures not stated in AUDIT.md
cheapest_catch: Same as item A: grep cached sources/cryptiana/web/francis.htm for 'fr.3040' ('both deciphered'), match Anc. 8565 (BnF cc49499h) to Le Grand's Bethune 8565 heading in the MDZ OCR dateline list, and view canvases 32-33 once for the margin gloss; L&P iv(3) by be-api fts 'Tarbes Montmorency' on 11332111bsb.

The gate should route such items to 'key check, not a reading', not refuse them. Audit 1's L&P spelling miss and the misleading DECODE 'Non-decrypted' flag recur here.
